However in case of Electronic forms printouts of such applications need not be retained or sent to the issuer. Intermediaries shall at all times maintain the electronic records relating to such forms for a minimum period of three years."

dataList.value: "11-Sep-2026 (upto 5:00 PM) The new cut-off time for UPI mandate acceptance is 05:00 PM on last day of IPO bidding.
